installCommand: git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git --depth 1 -b 3.47.4 flutter-sdk && ./flutter-sdk/bin/flutter --version && ./flutter-sdk/bin/flutter precache --web && ./flutter-sdk/bin/flutter pub get
buildCommand: if [ "$AQARATI_TARGET" = "admin" ]; then ./flutter-sdk/bin/flutter build web -t lib/admin_main.dart --release --pwa-strategy=none --no-web-resources-cdn --dart-define=AQARATI_DEMO_MODE=${AQARATI_DEMO_MODE:-false}; else ./flutter-sdk/bin/flutter build web --release --pwa-strategy=none --no-web-resources-cdn --dart-define=AQARATI_DEMO_MODE=${AQARATI_DEMO_MODE:-false}; fi
